scope: New console-to-console and console-to-desktop targets found in primary maintainer repositories; deduplicated against the 847-project SQLite catalog by repository and source→target.

projects.title: Animal Crossing Native PC Port
projects.status: Playtest release v0.9.3-playtest; a prebuilt Windows release and source build are documented. Only USA GAFE01_00 Rev 0 is supported, and the user must provide the disc image.
projects.summary: Native x86 PC port built from the Animal Crossing C decompilation. The GameCube GX graphics API is translated to OpenGL 3.3; no game assets or assembly are included.
projects.strategy: Decompilation-based native PC port with GX-to-OpenGL 3.3 translation
projects.source_available: Public source and Windows releases; requires the user's own USA GAFE01_00 Rev 0 disc image

sources.label: Maintainer README: method, supported disc, and build instructions

projects.title: Mario Kart Wii WiiCompiled PC Port
projects.status: Playable development build; the maintainer says gameplay should be playable and ghost runs match original physics, while compatibility, rendering, networking, and performance remain under active work. Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+ are listed; only a clean PAL RMCP01 dump is accepted.
projects.summary: Native PC port using static recompilation: Wii PowerPC code is translated ahead of time and compiled for the host, with no Wii CPU emulator, interpreter, or JIT at runtime. No game code or assets are distributed.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation to native desktop code
projects.source_available: Public source and installer releases; user supplies a clean PAL RMCP01 disc image

sources.label: Maintainer README: technique, supported hosts, exact disc revision, and compatibility status
Maintainer releases: Windows and macOS installers

projects.title: Ship of Harkinian Switch Port
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.status: Switch NRO release and Atmosphère title-override install steps are documented; CI builds are explicitly for playtesting and may contain bugs or crashes. The reviewed README does not establish full-game compatibility.
projects.summary: Nintendo Switch target of Ship of Harkinian, built on the Ocarina of Time decompilation and libultraship. The Switch package uses the user's prepared .o2r game-data file and does not include copyrighted assets.
projects.strategy: Decompilation-based native port using Ship of Harkinian and libultraship
projects.source_available: Public source, Switch NRO release, and CI playtest builds; requires the user's supported ROM and prepared game-data files

sources.label: Maintainer README: Switch install, input requirements, and playtest caveat

projects.title: Super Mario Sunshine Native PC Port
projects.platform: Nintendo GameCube → Windows, Linux, and macOS
projects.status: Linux x86, Linux x86-64, and Intel macOS/Rosetta builds are listed as playable; Linux x86-64 is still being checked stage by stage. The Windows build boots under Wine while native runtime checks continue. Only North American GMSE01 Rev 0 is supported.
projects.summary: Native PC port compiled from the matching Super Mario Sunshine decompilation. It reads game data from the user's disc image and includes no game data; build and run scripts and a separate setup launcher are documented.
projects.source_available: Public source and launcher releases; requires the user's own GMSE01 Rev 0 disc image
